Headline: 1.2 Crore Units Promoter Shares of Machhapuchchhre Bank in Auction from Today
Full Content:
Surendra Mahato is auctioning 1,12,32,492 units of promoter shares of
Machhapuchchhre Bank Limited (MBL)
. The auction is open from today i.e. on 5th Magh to 15th Magh, 2080.
Earlier, the promoter initially attempted to sell 1,12,32,492 units of promoter shares to existing promoter shareholders at a minimum bid rate of Rs. 100. However, as no bids were received during the auction period from 25th Ashwin, 2080, the unsold shares were subsequently made available to the general public, interested promoter shareholders, and institutions from 25th Poush to 2nd Magh at a revised minimum bid rate of Rs. 115.
Again, the same 1,12,32,492 units of previously unsold promoter shares are in the auction from today to qualified interested promoter shareholders including the general public and institutions. These promoter shares constitute approximately 18.95% of the total promoter shares, representing a 51% ownership stake in MBL. With a total of 11.62 Crore units of shares listed on the Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE), these shares being auctioned constitute about 9.66% of the total shares. This auction is expected to attract the attention of investors and may have an impact on the ownership structure of MBL.
Qualified interested promoters shareholders including the general public and institutions are eligible to bid in an auction. Rs. 113 is the minimum bid rate. The minimum bid quantity for promoters’ shares is 1,00,000 units. The shareholders should submit their bids at Machhapuchchhre Capital Limited located at Baghdurbar, JDA Complex, Kathmandu.
MBL closed at Rs. 204.00 yesterday. Meanwhile, MBLPO has an LTP of Rs. 136.00 as of May 10, 2023.

Headline: Machhapuchchhre Bank to auction 1.60 lakh units unsubscribed right shares at Rs 100 & above
Full Content:
Machhapuchchhre Bank Limited (MBL)
had floated 12% (79,18,440 unit) right shares to its shareholders from Shrawan 5, 2074 till Bhadra 7, 2074. The bank has published notice of allotment of right shares today.

It has allotted only 77,57,697.36 unit right shares as per right share allotment notice and remaining 1,60,742.64 units (2.02%) was unclaimed by the shareholders.

Now, the unclaimed 1.60 lakh units right shares will  be sold through auction.

MBL’s paid up capital currently remains at Rs 6.59 arba. After this right share issuance, its paid up capital will reach Rs 7.39 arba. Its authorized capital is Rs 10 arba. As per NRB’s directive for all commercial banks to increase their paid up capital to a minimum of Rs 8 arba by the end of FY 2073/74, MBL has to issue a further capital hike of Rs 61 crore (around 8.25%).

MBL has earned net profit of Rs 1.30 arba until the end of fourth quarter of FY 2073/74.
